question: Which Australian cricketer, known as "Mr. Dependable", was inducted into Cricket Australia's Hall of Fame in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Michael Bevan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Former Australian cricketer Michael Bevan was inducted into Cricket Australia's Hall of Fame for his outstanding contributions to ODI cricket.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Michael Bevan played 232 ODIs, scoring 6,912 runs at an average of 53.58.
 
• He was a key middle-order batter and a specialist in finishing run chases under pressure.
 
• Part of Australia’s 1999 and 2003 ICC Cricket World Cup-winning teams.
 
• He played international cricket from 1994 to 2004, primarily batting at No. 6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ricky Ponting**__:

 __
 
• Former Australian captain and three-time World Cup winner (1999, 2003, 2007).
 
• One of Australia's greatest batsmen across all formats.
 
 
 
• **Steve Waugh**__:
 __
 
• Led Australia to 1999 Cricket World Cup victory.
 
• Known for his gritty leadership and resilience under pressure.
 
 
 
• **Adam Gilchrist**__:
 
 
• Explosive wicketkeeper-batsman and a key player in Australia’s golden era.
 
• Played crucial roles in Australia’s 1999, 2003, and 2007 World Cup wins.
